pages.title: Combatting Inflation and Record High Gas Prices | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Combatting Inflation and Record High Gas Prices
During President Joe Biden’s first summer in office, Todd Young penned an op-ed in The Northwest Indiana Times where he warned that the policies advocated by Biden and the Democrat Party would make inflation worse.
While Biden brushed aside the criticism as temporary, the following summer the Biden Administration admitted that they misjudged inflation, and today the pace of inflation is increasing at levels that we haven’t seen since the early 80s.
In the Senate, Todd knows that sounding the alarm on inflation is not enough. That’s why Todd supports measures to reduce federal spending and oppose taxpayer-funded boondoggles like Build Back Better so that we can lower inflation, which will let Hoosiers keep more of their hard-earned money.
Additionally, when Joe Biden took office, the price of gas was $2.39, and due to his energy policies that price has steadily gone up. Todd has made clear that we need to expand our domestic energy supply and that includes utilizing the Keystone XL pipeline, that Joe Biden shutdown.
Nobody is fighting harder on inflation than Todd Young. It’s no surprise that the Indianapolis Star has recently recognized him for his hard work on this.

pages.title: Securing the Border | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## A Proven Record of Securing Our Border.
While in the Marines, Todd served on the Arizona-Mexico border to keep drugs from illegally entering our country, so he knows firsthand how important it is to secure our southern border. Todd has also voted for funding to secure our border through technology, drones, and a physical barrier to keep drugs, human trafficking and criminals out of our country.
Todd has made it clear to President Joe Biden that he is unhappy with his unlawful decision to suspend border wall construction and order to freeze funds provided by Congress to secure our border. He is also frustrated that Vice President Kamala Harris has not taken the crisis seriously, as she has yet to visit our southern border to properly assess the problem.
In 2021, Todd visited the southern border to witness the historic crisis under President Biden.
Through his service in the Marines and his voting record, Todd has a proven record of securing our southern border.

pages.title: Confirming Constitutionalist Judges | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Todd Led the Fight to Confirm Justice Amy Coney Barrett.
Todd believes it’s important to confirm judicial nominees who will interpret the Constitution as it was written, instead of legislating from the bench.
Todd has supported the confirmation of 234 constitutionalist federal judges, which includes Supreme Court Justice Neil Gorsuch, Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh, and Supreme Court Justice Amy Coney Barrett.
Additionally, Todd was instrumental in convincing President Donald Trump to select Justice Amy Coney Barrett to the Supreme Court and he introduced her at the Senate Judiciary Committee hearing. Without Todd’s leadership, we would not have Justice Amy Coney Barrett on the Supreme Court.
In 2022, Todd opposed Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson’s nomination to the Supreme Court. He has also worked to thwart attempts by Democrats to pack the Supreme Court and believes there should only be 9 Supreme Court Justices.

pages.title: Supporting Law Enforcement | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Todd is Fighting the Radical Defund the Police Agenda.
Todd has spent his entire life standing with law enforcement and he proudly wrote the Police Mental Health bill that was signed into law by President Donald Trump. Todd has stood up to Speaker Nancy Pelosi, Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and radical leftists in Washington who want to defund the police. He has also never supported legislation to reform qualified immunity, which is another anti-law enforcement cause championed by liberal Democrats.
Todd has met with law enforcement officials across the state and will always stand with the individuals protecting our communities.

pages.title: Protecting the Unborn | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## An A+ Rating from National Right to Life and Susan B. Anthony List.
Todd is proudly endorsed by National Right to Life and Susan B. Anthony List and has cosponsored numerous pro-life bills, including the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act and the Pain-Capable Unborn Child Protection Act. Todd believes the federal government should defund Planned Parenthood and has also worked to end taxpayer funded abortions.
In addition to his legislative record, Todd has voted for conservative judges including Supreme Court nominees Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh and Amy Coney Barrett, who we can count on to protect the unborn.
Todd was honored to March for Life and speak to over a thousand Hoosiers who are committed to protecting the unborn in the face of the Biden Administration’s pro-abortion agenda. Watch Todd’s speech:

pages.title: Protecting the Second Amendment | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## An A+ Rating from the NRA.
Todd has an A+ rating from the NRA, because throughout his time serving our state he has stood up and opposed anti-Second Amendment legislation championed by President Joe Biden, Vice President Kamala Harris, Speaker Nancy Pelosi, former President Barack Obama and former New York City Mayor Michael Bloomberg.
Todd has also voted for conservative Supreme Court nominees including Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh and personally recommended Amy Coney Barrett to President Donald Trump, because he knows they will protect our Second Amendment rights.

pages.title: Standing Up for Veterans | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Standing Up for Veterans
Todd has spent a decade serving our country in the military, and helping our veterans is something that he takes personally.
Todd was disgusted by President Barack Obama’s Veterans Affairs scandal of negligence in the treatment of military veterans and proudly supported the Veterans Access to Care Act. He has also introduced legislation that helps veterans address the opioids crisis, along with bipartisan legislation to curb veteran homelessness.
Todd has also worked to ensure our veterans receive their proper medals for their service and has always fought to make sure they receive the benefits that they have earned.

pages.title: Affordability | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Todd Young is Fighting to Keep Hoosiers’ Costs Low.
When President Biden first took office, Todd Young warned that the administration’s economic agenda would fuel inflation. He was right. Inflation surged to levels not seen since the early 1980s, hurting Hoosier families and small businesses.
Todd worked relentlessly to rein in inflation. The Indianapolis Star took notice of his leadership as he opposed costly, taxpayer-funded boondoggles like Build Back Better and pushed back against the radical left’s extreme environmental policies that drove energy and gas prices higher.
Since President Trump returned to office in 2025, Republicans have been working to undo President Biden’s runaway spending and restore fiscal sanity. That’s why Todd supports the One Big, Beautiful Bill Act, delivering historic tax relief for working and middle-class families, including eliminating taxes on tips and overtime. He also backs President Trump’s efforts to eliminate wasteful spending from bloated federal government programs.
Today, Todd is leading the effort to address the housing affordability crisis facing millions of Americans. He is working to cut unnecessary regulations and expand the housing supply for all income levels so more Hoosiers can purchase a home of their own.
Keeping costs low for Hoosiers is Todd’s top priority.

pages.title: Banning Congressional Stock Trading | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## Leading the Fight to Restore Integrity in Washington and Stop Swamp Trading.
Today, only 17% of Americans say they trust the federal government–That’s a crisis career politicians created and it’s why Todd is fighting to restore trust in our institutions.
Todd believes members of Congress should never leverage positions of public trust to enrich themselves and their families. That’s why he has never traded a stock while serving in Washington.
Lawmakers write and pass bills that significantly impact the market, sit on committees that oversee entire sectors of America’s economy, and have access to briefings that provide nonpublic market information.
Insider trading is illegal for everyone else. Members of Congress should be held to the same standard.
That’s why Todd is championing legislation like the Stop Insider Trading Act and the Restore Trust in Congress Act to ban members of Congress from trading individual stocks.
You can read more about his efforts to “Ban Swamp Trading” in the IndyStar.

pages.title: Securing the Border | Todd Young for U.S. Senate
pages.text:
## A Proven Record of Securing Our Border.
As a Marine, Todd served on the U.S.-Mexico border working firsthand to stop illegal drugs and human traffickers from entering our country. He understands that border security is national security.
Todd has been outspoken in opposing the Biden administration’s disastrous border policies, which left Americans vulnerable to fentanyl, gang violence, and human trafficking.
After visiting the southern border in 2021, Todd demanded accountability—pressing then–CBP nominee Chris Magnus to acknowledge the situation as a true crisis.
Partnering with the Trump administration, Todd helped restore order by advancing key legislation such as the Laken Riley Act, the HALT Fentanyl Act, and the One Big, Beautiful Bill Act, which invested heavily in border security. Within months, illegal crossings dropped by more than 95%, and control was restored.
From his service in uniform to his leadership in Washington, Todd Young has delivered real results securing America’s border.
